restoration_note: Teaching catechizes that all the 'great-garment' names (Jesus, pearls, icons, tunics-of-work, element of light, Cross of Light, Counsel of Life, the slain soul) designate one reality — the Living Soul / Divine Truth dispersed in the natural — which at the consummation will collapse back into one likeness, one name, in its first substance. Most gaps are editor-proposed completions of words split by line breaks (Ⲡⲱⲙⲟϥⲟⲣⲟⲥ, ϯⲟ̄ⲁⲙ, ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ, ⲍⲗⲍⲁⲗⲧ, ⲍⲃⲏⲩⲉ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ, ⲉϣⲁϩϣⲟⲟⲩⲉ, ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲓⲉ) or standard idioms (ϯⲣⲉⲛ + suffix, ϫⲱⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲛⲥⲉ- conjunctive). These are accepted with high confidence. Larger lacunae in the closing eschatological section (gaps {36}–{42}, {44}) and a few unbounded short gaps ({9},{11},{12},{13},{15}) lack sufficient grammatical or lexical anchors and are marked unrestorable. Gap {23} (10 char) was filled tentatively from the reading's image of the Cross-of-Light 'stretched out wholly upon the land,' using ⲡⲱⲣϣ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ.
